rv.q: Culture | Theatre Close to You: Bacharach Reimagined, theatre review – Just walk on by... Bacharach’s back catalogue is a joyous thing, says Fiona Mountford, but musical director Kyle Riabko adds almost nothing to it Versatile: Anastacia McCleskey with Stephanie McKeon, left, and the show’s musical director and lead vocalist, Kyle Riabko, right...
Yet this straight musical retread through the Burt Bacharach songbook shows how well the genre can work.
It is therefore an absolute pleasure to see his music so thrillingly and modernly re-imagined in ‘Close to You: Bacharach Reimagined’ at the Criterion Theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise this thrilling, modern reimagining of Burt Bacharach's innovative compositions, celebrating how the show transforms his jazz-influenced pop classics with fresh energy and musicianship.
